resources.string: Set up opening Spotify, Apple Music… links

Android sends links from sites like Spotify, Apple Music, Deezer and YouTube Music to the browser or the service\'s own app, because Onetune can\'t claim those websites itself. You have to allow it once, so Onetune can offer to open the song in the service you prefer.

In the next screen, tap \"Add link\" and select open.spotify.com, music.apple.com, www.deezer.com and music.youtube.com. If the service\'s own app is installed, also remove these links from its \"Open by default\" settings.
Resolve and share links through your own server
Leave empty to use the default server. Links you share will point to this server.
